integrity: Infinite conclusions have self-contained analytical proof; finite exact-rational computations check arithmetic and conventions, not infinite quantifiers. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Result applies to iid fair signs in a two-dimensional reducible triangular cocycle with \(0<\mu/\lambda<1/2\) and \(0<c<\lambda(1-\mu/\lambda)\). Nonoverlap and bi-Lipschitz restrictions are explicit. Other affine-cocycle formulations may overlap.
title: A sharp fractal boundary layer at the equator of triangular random matrix products
